question: On the FOUR_PCT (any 4% up day) cohort, do LOWER adr20 stocks give a better stop-R than HIGH adr20 stocks, even though high-adr stocks showed bigger raw pops before? Expect NEGATIVE top-minus-bottom (low vol wins on stop-R).
plain: Low-volatility anomaly (Pandey; MAS 2022): tests whether calmer stocks (lower adr20) hold up better on stop-based risk-adjusted return after any 4% breakout day, not just raw price pop.
